goals.objective: Deep structural review of pss-runtime after mechanical slop cleanup. Five goals: (1) Remove 19 barrel re-export files created during module splits — migrate all imports to direct module paths, delete the barrels. (2) Detect and fix circular dependencies introduced by the splits. (3) Merge over-split modules under 30 pure LOC back into their parent modules where they lack standalone responsibility. (4) Review domain boundaries: thread/plugin/execution/platform layering — identify misplaced responsibilities. (5) Audit public API surface: find exported symbols with zero external consumers and remove or internalize them. All changes must keep 807 tests green and typecheck clean. Single PR continuation on refactor/remove-ai-slop branch.
